pr.title: Fixes #344081: Improve test diagnostics and error logging for chat input automation helper
pr.body:
Fixes #344081

## Description
This PR enhances error diagnostics for the chat input Playwright automation helper.

When no chat input element is found after keyboard shortcuts and command palette fallbacks, the runner now gathers selector-level metrics (candidate count, visibility, and exclusion status) before throwing an error.

## Benefits
- Provides clear diagnostic insights directly in CI/CD pipeline logs.
- Reduces debugging overhead when identifying flaky tests.
